canonical_project: ECCAS / PIDA PAP2 Central African Republic Data Center
owner: ECCAS / PIDA / Government of Central African Republic
notes: OECD's Africa's Development Dynamics 2025 states that data centers are a priority in the 2019 ECCAS electronic-communications infrastructure master plan, with a USD 92.5 million PIDA PAP2 initiative for six new data centers including one in the Central African Republic. Public material found in this run did not identify a subnational site; Bangui is inferred as the likely national hub.
